results.content: The Economist's YouGov polling tracker, last updated August 4, showed Trump with a net approval rating of -25, with 35 percent of respondents approving of his performance and 60 percent disapproving. The tracker attributed part of the decline to the administration's resumption of strikes on Iran in mid-July, a conflict that 60 percent of respondents said was costing the government too much money.
